shots.focal_element: A horizontal row of six app icon tiles (Google Drive, Slack, Notion, Jira, GitHub, Salesforce) inside a pale rounded pill tray
shots.transition_other: video start: icons enter from an empty off-white background with motion blur (no incoming shot)
shots.what_happens: The six integration icons fly in left to right with heavy motion blur and settle into a centered row; a soft rounded tray fades in behind them; then a grey dimming highlight steps across the icons one at a time (Drive, Slack, ... GitHub) as if scanning, and in the last second the camera pushes in hard so the tray fills the frame and only the first four icons remain visible, with the Notion tile dimmed.
shots.build_rebuild: Stagger six 120px rounded-square icon tiles into a flex row with a translateX+blur(12px)->0 entrance (~80ms stagger), fade in a rounded pill container behind them, step a 50%-grey overlay across tiles one per beat, then scale the whole group ~2.5x toward the left with an ease-in-out push.

shots.focal_element: Close-up of the Google Drive and Slack tiles inside the tray, with the Notion tile cropped at right
shots.what_happens: A sub-second tight crop on the tray: the grey dimming highlight moves between the Drive and Slack tiles (Drive dimmed in the keyframe, Slack dimmed in the 6.5s sheet frame), continuing the scanning rhythm at close range.
shots.build_rebuild: Hard-cut to the same icon tray scaled ~3x and offset so Drive and Slack fill the frame, and toggle the grey overlay from one tile to the next on the music beat.

shots.focal_element: Close-up of the Notion, Jira and GitHub tiles with the grey highlight passing over Jira then GitHub
shots.typography: Bold geometric sans-serif (Inter-like, low confidence), sentence case, tight tracking, centered; words fade in individually from light grey to dark grey.
shots.what_happens: Another tight crop further along the tray, panned right: the dimming highlight steps from Jira to GitHub; by the final sampled frame (7.5s) the icons are gone and the headline begins on a blank off-white field with "Can’t" visible and "find" fading in.
shots.build_rebuild: Hard-cut to the tray framed on tiles 3-5, step the grey overlay across Jira and GitHub on consecutive beats, then cut to a blank background and start a per-word opacity fade-in of the headline.

shots.composition_other: centered headline and icon row in the first half; re-laid out to split (headline left, UI modal right) in the second half
shots.focal_element: Black bold headline text, then a Notion-to-Slack 'Select channels to connect' modal on the right
on_screen_text: Can’t find what you’re looking for?
Include channels created in the future
shots.typography: Bold/semibold neo-grotesque sans-serif (Inter or Notion's own sans, low confidence), sentence case, slightly tight tracking, two-line centered headlines; each word fades in from grey to near-black in sequence. Modal uses small regular-weight UI sans with a bold title and a filled blue button label.
shots.what_happens: "Can’t find what you’re looking for?" builds word by word and holds; the six-icon row returns centered, then the icons collapse/merge into a single Notion logo which shrinks and disappears; "Introducing Notion AI connectors" builds word by word centered, then slides left as a Notion+Slack 'Select channels to connect' modal slides in from the right; a cursor ticks the channel checkboxes (#all-kudos, #all-pets, #all-project-horizon), then 'Include channels created in the future', then moves to the blue Connect button; at the end the frame clears and "Access all" begins building. A small subtitle line under the modal title is too small to read.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a 2-line centered headline with per-word opacity 0.3->1 staggered ~150ms, then re-show the icon row and scale/converge the tiles into one Notion icon that scales to 0; build the second headline the same way, then animate it translateX to the left third while a shadowed modal card slides in from the right and a scripted cursor clicks checkbox rows and the Connect button.
